claims.text: Alosetron: start 0.5 mg twice a day;
claims.quote: LOTRONEX should be started at a dosage of 0.5 mg twice a day.

claims.text: if well tolerated but not controlling symptoms after 4 weeks, it can go up to 1 mg twice a day;
claims.quote: If after 4 weeks the dosage is well tolerated but does not adequately control IBS symptoms, then the dosage can be increased to up to 1 mg twice a day

claims.text: stop if not controlled after 4 weeks on 1 mg twice a day.
claims.quote: LOTRONEX should be discontinued in patients who have not had adequate control of IBS symptoms after 4 weeks of treatment with 1 mg twice a day.

claims.text: Boxed warning: serious GI reactions, including ischemic colitis and serious complications of constipation, have led to hospitalization and, rarely, transfusion, surgery and death;
claims.quote: Infrequent but serious gastrointestinal adverse reactions have been reported with the use of LOTRONEX. These events, including ischemic colitis and serious complications of constipation, have resulted in hospitalization, and rarely, blood transfusion, surgery, and death.

claims.text: stop it immediately if constipation or signs of ischemic colitis develop, and don't restart it after ischemic colitis.
claims.quote: LOTRONEX should be discontinued immediately in patients who develop constipation or signs of ischemic colitis. LOTRONEX should not be restarted in patients who develop ischemic colitis.

claims.text: Contraindicated with fluvoxamine, a strong CYP1A2 inhibitor that raises alosetron AUC about 6-fold.
claims.quote: Concomitant administration of LOTRONEX with fluvoxamine is contraindicated. Fluvoxamine, a known strong inhibitor of CYP1A2, has been shown to increase mean alosetron plasma concentrations (AUC) approximately 6-fold
